class Holder:
 values=(x+1 for x in range(3))
g=Holder.values
print(callable(g.send),callable(g.throw),callable(g.close))
print(g.send(None))
g.close()
print(list(g))

def make():
 scale=10
 class Holder:
  scale=99
  values=(scale+x for x in range(2))
 scale=20
 return Holder.values
g=make()
print(g.send(None),next(g))

scale=3
class Holder:
 scale=99
 values=(scale+x for x in range(2))
print(Holder.values.send(None),next(Holder.values))

class Holder:
 values=(((outer,inner) for inner in range(2)) for outer in range(3))
first=next(Holder.values)
second=next(Holder.values)
print(first.send(None),second.send(None))
first.close()
second.close()
Holder.values.close()

class Holder:
 marker:(value+1 for value in range(2))
g=Holder.__annotations__['marker']
print(g.send(None))
g.close()
print(list(g))
